topic.analysis: US beginner inflation literacy: nominal versus real wealth, cash drag, fixed-rate debt, asset ownership and emergency liquidity. Audience cash-heavy cautious savers/homebuying adults; primary problem confusing nominal account growth with purchasing power. Evergreen mechanism, recent-shock history and current prices support relatability; two-person longitudinal scenario is illustrative, not novel empirical research.
